title: Baalbek trilithon stones

tellings.quote: There's a series of stones called the trilithan stones, which are raised about 30 ft above the foundation blocks and placed with precision. They weigh conservative range 800 tons each, coming up to about 1,000 tons.

plain: At Baalbek in Lebanon, a set of huge blocks called the trilithon stones sit about 30 feet above the foundation blocks and were placed with precision, and each one weighs at least 800 tons and maybe close to 1,000. A guest named Jay Anderson describes them to Michels without naming a source. He brings them up as an example of ancient building so heavy and exact that it is hard to explain how it was done.
